summary: Project expanded to include backend setup in addition to the existing frontend/styling work.

existing_features.title: Ensure the backend API surface supports the existing frontend integration by keeping the submitInquiry signature compatible with frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts and providing a query method to retrieve inquiries (e.g., getAllInquiries) that returns stored inquiries.

new_feature_requests.summary: Set up the backend (server/API and related infrastructure) for the project.
Update the Motoko backend actor (backend/main.mo) to persist submitted inquiries across canister upgrades by storing inquiries in stable state instead of only in-memory variables.

Align backend validation with the frontend forms by validating all required fields for inquiry submission (name, country, email, category, message) and returning clear English error messages when validation fails.

projectName: Set up backend canister to support inquiry submissions
